_readme_scheme_switch: Top-level "scheme": xvla_pybullet_drone_demo.py uses the matching block directly. xvla_widowx_drone_demo.py merges widowx_ee6d workspace/task with numeric scheme 1/2/3 gui, sim_steps, xvla_infer_gap, etc.; scheme widowx_ee6d uses only that block. Legacy key widowx_scheme can still select the workspace block. CLI: --scheme overrides top-level scheme. Numeric scheme blocks may set gate_pose_estimator (opencv|xvla) to override widowx_ee6d gate pose estimation.

common._readme_gate_pose_estimator: xvla_widowx_drone_demo only: rectangular portal opening orientation (when fpv_use_sim_truth_pose=false). gate_pose_estimator must be opencv or xvla; common may provide default, schemes.widowx_ee6d or numeric 1/2/3 merge may override. Top-level same-name key overrides last (see merge logic).
common.instruction: Fly to the target while avoiding obstacles

1.label: Visual debug: default GUI + faster simulation

2.label: Fast batch run: no GUI + large infer steps + less logging

widowx_ee6d.label: Drone=WidowX EE: EE6D semantics flight in arm workspace (xvla_widowx_drone_demo.py)
widowx_ee6d.instruction: Sequential flight through rectangular portals in task order; each subtask names billboard_id matching the top marker (1–20).
widowx_ee6d._auto_motion: When true, auto-adjust pos_lerp_alpha and delta_pos_scale by workspace size, infer gap, and language-only task (--cmd or task_sequence: []). auto_motion_ref_diag_m is calibration reference diagonal (m). CLI: --auto-motion / --no-auto-motion.
widowx_ee6d._language_only_motion: Only without task_sequence / --cmd: amplify wrist-local target displacement from model. language_only_motion_amplify=multiplier along drone→target displacement; language_only_min_step_local_m=local min target distance after workspace clip (m). CLI: --cmd-motion-amplify / --cmd-min-step.
widowx_ee6d._cmd_color_disambiguation: With --cmd: if sentence contains a color word present in scene cubes (e.g. yellow), append English sentence to X-VLA language_instruction emphasizing that color portal only; independent of billboard append. billboard_id numbering usually skips color append (may trigger id-specific append). false disables color append.
widowx_ee6d._infer_displacement_scale: On each X-VLA /act target refresh, multiply decoded target displacement in wrist-local frame (after target_pull and language-only boost), then clip to workspace; 1.0 unchanged. Independent of sim-step pos_lerp. CLI: --infer-displacement-scale.
widowx_ee6d._xvla_scene_semantic_context: When true (default) with with_objects and scene objects: prepend full-object English catalog aligned to simulation and workspace lo/hi to each /act language_instruction, plus path/safety suffix for spatial semantics from top/slant images. --no-xvla-scene-catalog disables.
widowx_ee6d._xvla_path_planning_instruction_suffix: Non-empty string overrides default English path-planning suffix; empty string uses built-in default.
widowx_ee6d._local_avoidance: Near-field artificial-potential repulsion on inflated obstacle AABBs: deflect world-frame target_pos (phase1 lerp); phase2 P-control error vector plus repulsion. Objects near goal/subgoal (center distance ≤ local_avoidance_exclude_goal_tol_m) excluded. --no-local-avoidance disables.
widowx_ee6d._cmd_global_camera: Only --cmd without task_sequence: color segmentation at workspace X-VLA camera resolution/FOV, ray intersect portal opening plane for world target, blend with decoded target via cmd_global_cam_pull_alpha (0=off). Opening normal from sim tilt_deg/yaw_deg (real robot needs extrinsics/depth). Below cmd_global_cam_min_area_ratio mask area falls back to portal catalog center. CLI: --cmd-global-cam / --no-cmd-global-cam / --cmd-global-cam-pull P.
widowx_ee6d._navigation_phase2: Phase 2: top-down corridor grid A* (inflate Phase1 obstacle XY) for coarse path and blue polyline; portal frames use four-bar AABBs (hole passable). navigation_phase1_corridor_margin_m expands green corridor margin. Closed-loop /act still uses slant workspace camera; top-down X-VLA only when navigation_phase2_optional_topdown_xvla=true.
widowx_ee6d._navigation_sim_recording_view_scales: sim/ recording camera distance scale per view (× base scale; >1 farther, <1 closer). right=1.3, top=1.1, 45deg=0.7; front unchanged.
widowx_ee6d._navigation_use_phase3_path: true: after Phase3 do not exit; replay refined trajectory as polyline interpolation into main sim (no X-VLA /act during sim), record world_*.mp4|gif in recordings/<ts>/sim/. May combine with cmd_coarse_plan_once:true (Phase1+2+3 then sim). false with cmd_coarse_plan_once:true exits after Phase3. navigation_collision_pad_m null aligns with astar_obstacle_pad.
widowx_ee6d._navigation_phase3: Phase 3: feedback sphere alpha; with GUI and navigation_recording_use_opengl=true use ER_BULLET_HARDWARE_OPENGL for true transparency (DIRECT/TinyRenderer uses OpenCV 2D overlay).
widowx_ee6d._language_air_path: Language-only --cmd with figure-eight / in the air / over the workspace / patrol etc.: clamp decoded local Z to mid cruise band in workspace and cap global camera pull to language_only_air_path_max_cam_pull to avoid ground portal targets pulling low; segments still from X-VLA. language_only_cruise_z_clamp=false disables Z clamp.
widowx_ee6d._language_only_demo_trajectory: No task_sequence and scenic command (pattern above workspace, figure-eight, circuit, etc.) not through-portal: each /act raises local Z to workspace ground (virtual_base) + language_only_demo_height_factor×max object height above ground (default 1.44≈20% above prior 1.2); blend decoded XY with parametric overlay via language_only_demo_plan_blend_beta; fill/edge_margin/period below. false disables.
widowx_ee6d._language_only_demo_xvla_trajectory_once: Scenic non-portal commands: first /act with steps=max(--xvla-steps, language_only_demo_traj_plan_steps) for full action sequence, decode waypoints and lift to z_min; sim steps interpolate by arc length only, no further X-VLA. false reverts to per-step inference + original figure-eight blend.
widowx_ee6d._language_only_demo_plan_topdown: Scenic one-shot planning: true uses get_world_recording_rgb(view_kind=top) same as recording top for X-VLA input; false uses slant workspace camera.
widowx_ee6d._language_only_demo_fill_xy: After planning, affine-map decoded waypoint XY bbox to scene object top-down AABB (shrunk margin) ∩ current workspace top rectangle so trajectory fills object occupancy in top view; large margin may degenerate.
widowx_ee6d._language_only_demo_scenic_xy_force: One-shot scenic: after prior top rectangle, replace with workspace XY center square, side = language_only_demo_scenic_xy_force_long_scale × workspace long side, shared by figure-eight, ellipse, and rectangle-remap stunts.
widowx_ee6d._fpv_slot_align: Near target within fpv_slot_align_dist: gate-pose camera render + rect frame pose override target_R. gate_pose_use_dedicated_camera uses dedicated pose. fpv_use_sim_truth_pose=true uses sim quaternion; false gate_pose_estimator=opencv (color seg + long-edge tilt) or xvla (gate RGB + X-VLA 6D rotation, slower). gate_pose_cv_fallback_map_pose / gate_pose_xvla_fallback_opencv control fallback.
widowx_ee6d._gate_pose_estimator: Matches gate_pose_estimator in this block: only when fpv_use_sim_truth_pose=false; opencv=color seg+long-edge tilt; xvla=gate image + X-VLA /act for 6D rotation (high latency). Allowed: opencv | xvla only.
widowx_ee6d._xvla_gate_instruction: English sent to dedicated gate-pose camera when gate_pose_estimator=xvla; placeholders {billboard_id}, {color}.
widowx_ee6d.xvla_gate_instruction_template: Orient end-effector with long opening of rectangular portal billboard_id={billboard_id} ({color}); pass through.
widowx_ee6d.task_default_phrase: Fly through rectangular portal billboard_id={billboard_id} ({color} visual); align with the long narrow opening.
widowx_ee6d._precision_notes: Two-phase algorithm: Phase1=X-VLA approach, switch to Phase2=P-control precision on stall or phase1_max_steps. target_pull_alpha: pull VLA output toward task_xyz (0=pure VLA, 1=pure geometry). target_snap_radius: snap to target center within this distance. movement_deadband: no move below this displacement, suppress jitter. phase1_stall_window: history window steps for stall detection. phase1_stall_threshold: min approach in window to count as stall. phase1_max_steps: max Phase1 steps per target for Phase2 time. phase2_p_gain: P-controller gain. phase2_max_speed: Phase2 max speed (m/s).
widowx_ee6d._readme_task_sequence_billboard: Each subtask instruction uses billboard_id=N, matching rect_frame order in cubes front-to-back and portal top markers 1–20; target_xyz remains corresponding frame center.
